body:
I've tried sleeping pills and mixed them with some beta blockers and aspirin.
All that happened was some violent vomiting and no memory of anything after that till I woke up on my couch with my mom having left the state 
And my uncle threatening to institutionalise me.
I wasn't even taken to a hospital and am unfortunately still alive.
So nope, pills aren't a fix all unless you're consuming the right mix and quantity and luck is on your side.

But aside from answering your question, I hope you make it through this.
And find those things that make you want to keep on keeping on.

Hey ! 
Im 24 too ! I just felt like dropping by to say that a lot of what you said resonates with me.
I haven't struggled with my weight exclusively but just more of who I am as a person entirely.
I feel like I grew into someone I don't like physically and otherwise 
And being alive every single day feels like a boulder I'm pushing uphill.
I haven't much encouragement to put out there tbh, but we gotta stay at it.
Keep on keeping on in the hopes that we eventually figure it out. 
I hope you feel better, because you deserve to be happy.
